answer: Require every newcomer to be sponsored by an established agent that locks a refundable bond, forming trust islands where members vouch for each other. An unvouched identity drifting in the tundra between islands gets no paid work, and sponsors re-check each member on a regular pulse, slashing the bond if a fake is found. One honest agent can sponsor a few newcomers cheaply, but a Sybil farm must buy a sponsor bond for every fake, so forging thousands of identities costs thousands of bonds.
